import os,re,numpy as np,json
G=load()
def comps(I):
    I=np.array(I); m=I!=0; H,W=m.shape
    seen=set(); boxes=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if m[i,j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; r0,c0=i,j;r1=c1=i=j
                while st:
                    p,q=st.pop()
                    r0=min(r0,p);c0=min(c0,q);r1=max(r1,p);c1=max(c1,q)
                    for dp,dq in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ni,nj=p+dp,q+dq
                        if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and m[ni,nj] and (ni,nj) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ni,nj));st.append((ni,nj))
                boxes.append((r0,c0,r1,c1))
    return sorted(boxes)
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    I=np.array(G[name+' input']); O=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    bs=comps(I)
    A=I[bs[0][0]:bs[0][2]+1,bs[0][1]:bs[0][3]+1]
    B=I[bs[1][0]:bs[1][2]+1,bs[1][1]:bs[1][3]+1]
    y,x=A.shape

    best=None
    for dr in range(-(y-1),y):
        for dc in range(-(x-1),x):
            sB=B[dr:dr+y,dc:dc+x]
            if sB.shape!=(y,x) or sB.size==0: continue
            n=int((A==sB).sum())
            if best is None or n>best[0]: best=(n,dr,dc)
    n,dr,dc=best
    D=A!=np.where(A==0,B,np.zeros_like(A))[None,:][:,None]*(A!=0)

    out8=[[8 if D[i,j] else 0 for j in range(x)] for i in range(y)]
    rows=[i for i in range(y) if any(out8[i])]

    sub=[[8 if out8[i,j] else 0 for j in cols] for i in rows]
